verdict.rationale: Unleash's pricing page claims a dedicated dashboard for tracking stale feature flags, which covers the stale-flag discovery half of the story, but only as a one-line marketing mention. Nothing in the evidence shows code-reference scanning or any workflow that drives flag removal from the codebase. Missing for 10: code reference detection/scanning, documented stale-flag lifecycle and cleanup workflow, in-depth docs for the stale dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.
